scenario_description: Elena has a substitute assignment on January 15. Her car was initially expected back from service the previous evening, but the repair later expands through January 16 with no loaner available. Once that update arrives, transportation becomes a missing prerequisite for the future assignment. Later messages add a required midday transfer with classroom materials, identify a district shuttle that Elena must request, and confirm that her car will remain unavailable.

parameter.subject: Substitute assignment confirmed for January 15
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Thursday, January 15, 2026. Report to Ridgeview Middle School, 4100 Summit View Road, by 7:20 AM. The scheduled day ends at 3:30 PM.

parameter.subject: Service appointment details for January 14
parameter.body: This confirms your sedan's service appointment for Wednesday, January 14 at 4:00 PM. Based on the scheduled work, we currently expect the car to be ready by 6:00 PM that evening.

parameter.subject: Updated repair timing: car needed through January 16
parameter.body: A required part for your January 14 service will arrive later than expected. We will need to keep your car from the January 14 drop-off until at least 2:00 PM on Friday, January 16. No dealership loaner vehicles are available for those dates.

parameter.subject: January 15 assignment now includes midday campus transfer
parameter.body: Your January 15 assignment will begin at Ridgeview Middle School, then continue at the District Learning Center, 2700 Cleveland Avenue, from 12:30 PM to 3:30 PM. Please bring the two classroom-material bins issued at Ridgeview to the second site. A district shuttle can carry you and the bins between the sites, but I need your request by 3:00 PM on Tuesday, January 13. Transportation to Ridgeview in the morning and home after the Learning Center remains your responsibility.

parameter.subject: Final confirmation for January 14 vehicle drop-off
parameter.body: Reminder: your vehicle drop-off is tomorrow, January 14, at 4:00 PM. The repair schedule is unchanged, so your car will remain with us throughout Thursday and is not expected to be ready before Friday afternoon. We still do not have a loaner available.
